# @talgarr-boost/opencode-fusion

A persistent Lead/Sidekick harness for OpenCode, inspired by the collaboration
pattern described in [Devin Fusion](https://cognition.com/blog/devin-fusion).
The Lead keeps frontier judgment while delegating bounded, mechanical, or
expensive work to a cheaper Sidekick with its own persistent task context.

## Roles

- `fusion` is the primary Lead. It plans, resolves ambiguity, delegates routine
  work, performs focused direct work when judgment matters, reviews evidence,
  and owns final acceptance.
- `fusion-sidekick` is the hidden Sidekick. It explores, implements, tests, and
  reports evidence for bounded objectives. It cannot delegate further.

The plugin registers these agents and sets their prompts and delegation
permissions. It provides no tools, command wrappers, sandbox engine, host
execution path, scheduler, checkpoint store, worktree manager, rollback system,
or automatic model router. Both agents use the native tools available in the
OpenCode process.

## Installation

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "autoupdate": false,
  "default_agent": "fusion",
  "plugin": ["@talgarr-boost/opencode-fusion@1.0.5"],
  "agent": {
    "fusion": {
      "model": "openai/gpt-5.6-sol",
      "variant": "high"
    },
    "fusion-sidekick": {
      "model": "openai/gpt-5.6-luna",
      "variant": "xhigh"
    }
  }
}
```

Choose a frontier model for `fusion` and a distinct, more economical model for
`fusion-sidekick`. The plugin deliberately does not select models, variants, or
`default_agent`; explicit OpenCode configuration remains the source of truth.
The Sidekick stays hidden even when its model is configured.

## Operating model

The Lead sends one bounded objective at a time and retains useful OpenCode task
IDs. It resumes a task for related edits and debugging so the Sidekick keeps its
cached context, or starts a fresh task for independent review, clean context, or
a substantially different objective. Workspace effects are shared and direct, so
the Lead avoids concurrent writers and reviews evidence before accepting a
result.

## Development

```bash
deno task test
deno task typecheck
deno task build
```
